name: Find Templates by Table Dependency
description: Query to find all templates that have table dependencies (applicable_tables field is not null)
query:
query FindTemplatesWithTableDependencies {
  templatesWithTableDependencies {
    id
    identifier
    name
    description
    applicableTables
    tags
    complexityScore
    usageCount
    isActive
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
}
